title: Race day for runners – GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON 2027
claims: The 2027 GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON takes place on Sunday 26 September 2027.
The starting line is on Straße des 17. Juni, between the Brandenburg Gate and the 'Kleiner Stern'.
The 2027 run starts in six waves at 8:45, 9:05, 9:33, 10:02, 10:12 and 10:27 am.
The race takes place regardless of the weather unless the German Weather Service issues a weather warning.
The race bib is valid as a ticket in fare zones A, B and C from 23 to 26 September 2027.

Public transport stops near the start and finish are U-Bahn Unter den Linden, Bundestag, Brandenburger Tor and Potsdamer Platz; S-Bahn Brandenburger Tor, Berlin Central Station and Potsdamer Platz; regional trains Berlin Central Station and Potsdamer Platz.
The time limit is 6:15 hours and the cut-off point is at 3:50 PM at km 33.
Runners who miss the cut-off or time limit must leave the course and can take the sweep bus to the finish; continuing at their own risk is not permitted.
The finish line closes at 5:15 PM, after which it is no longer possible to run through the Brandenburg Gate or cross the finish line.
Only runners who provide proof of all split times and cross the finish mat before the finish line closes receive an official result, medal and poncho.
